items.title: Valve cracks down on Steam game submission process as questionable AI clones and vibe-coded slop flood its store
items.excerpt: Valve has tightened its Steam pre-release review checklist after a surge of submissions, widely linked to AI clones and vibe-coded games, pushed review times up to 12 business days. The new action is Valve's own Steamworks policy change, not a developer's complaint.

history_match.title: "Steam's review queue is clogged up by AI slop": Food Devils gets a delay because its devs think Valve is inundated with genAI games

items.title: Valve warns of slower Steam approvals, possibly due to AI game surge
items.excerpt: In a Tuesday Steamworks blog post Valve confirmed review delays after Next Fest submissions doubled historical highs, gave tips for clearing pre-review faster, and announced upcoming changes to the checklist testers verify before approving a release.

history_match.title: "Steam's review queue is clogged up by AI slop": Food Devils gets a delay because its devs think Valve is inundated with genAI games

items.title: Steamへのゲーム登録申請が急増し，審査に最大12営業日を要する状況に。生成AIを利用したゲーム開発の普及が背景にある可能性も
items.excerpt: Valve says a spike in Steam game submissions has stretched pre-release review from the usual 3-5 business days to as many as 12, and it has revised the review checklist; 4Gamer notes the spread of generative-AI game development as a likely cause.

history_match.title: "Steam's review queue is clogged up by AI slop": Food Devils gets a delay because its devs think Valve is inundated with genAI games

items.title: Google gets Henry Cavill to AI vibe code a game to promote Googlebook, promises to donate $11 to charity every time someone plays it
items.excerpt: Google has enlisted Henry Cavill to vibe-code a 16-bit side-scroller, 'Mustache Protocol', on a Googlebook, and is releasing a video series documenting the AI-assisted build; plays during November trigger Movember donations.

items.title: Hideo Kojima says AI lacks what makes the creative process fun, despite its efficiency
items.excerpt: In an interview with Game*Spark, Hideo Kojima said rapid AI advances have made game development far more manageable but that AI-driven creation is 'not a form of creation I find particularly interesting', voicing anxiety about AI's future role in creative work.

items.title: Metal Gear creator Hideo Kojima says he'll be dead by then, but worries AI will eventually play a key role in creative fields
items.excerpt: Kojima says he worries AI will eventually play a key role in creative fields, arguing that the fun of art is in making it: 'Getting a finished picture is not what's fun about drawing.'

items.title: 엔씨 AI, 지스타 2026서 생성형 AI 플랫폼 '바르코' 체험 카페 운영
items.excerpt: NC AI는 지스타 2026 기간(11월 19~21일) 부산 벡스코 인근에서 생성형 AI 플랫폼 '바르코' 체험 카페를 열고 3D 모델·사운드 생성 기술 체험과 1대1 상담을 제공하며, 10개 개발팀에 3개월 무료 이용을 지원한다.

items.title: Microsoft And Epic Games Suddenly Agree That AI Is Theft
items.excerpt: Kotaku argues that as Claude Opus 5.5-driven decompilations and vibe-coded browser ports flood out daily, publishers that embraced AI tools are now framing AI copying of their own games as theft.
